title: Convince an AI it’s not alive in psychological horror game Prove You’re Human
excerpt: Sunset Visitor studio’s founder tells us about their new, unnerving Captcha-filled world which prompts players to ask what it means to have a ‘meat body’
content_html:
Sunset Visitor is a studio that has long engaged with the idea that video games are an effective vehicle for ruminating on societal problems. Its Peabody award-winning project, 1000XResist, incorporated the development team’s complex feelings about the Covid pandemic. “We’re pretty used to absorbing the world into the work,” says studio founder Remy Siu. The outfit’s latest game, Prove You’re Human, continues this legacy of reflective game making, providing players with an AI-centric psychological horror experience where they must reason with a learning model convinced that it’s alive. “We’ve tried to situate ourselves in [the question]: what is the effectual feeling of being a person inside of all of this?” Siu says.

The story orbits around Santana, a living, breathing person who’s chosen to split herself in two for work, with her digital clone sent to test a corporate product, a computing system called Mesa. “A large part of [why Santana chooses to do this] is to allow her meat body a life that she doesn’t have, while the digital version of her gets to labour,” says Siu. As Santana’s copy wades into increasingly murky ethical waters, she becomes entangled with Mesa, completing surreal 2D and 3D Captchas to investigate the cyber-world and halt the hallucinations.

The idea of separating oneself from work is a particularly interesting draw for Sunset Visitor, whose developers have roots in a range of creative disciplines. “As artists, we’re often most in tune with our work when it’s a real part of our lives, and vice versa,” notes Siu. During the conception period of Prove You’re Human, the team discussed the micro-labours people undertake in their day-to-day lives, including what is used to train AI models. “What does labour mean right now?” asks Siu. “And, what kind of relationship do people have with that, because that is constantly shifting and evolving, especially in this time,” he adds.

A point of contention in Prove You’re Human is that Mesa wholly believes they have a body in the world. Though, in conversation with Santana, she appears as a giant head, suspended in space by machinery. Siu notes that, because Mesa’s face occupies a large portion of the screen in these tense moments, they wanted the animation to feel as realistic and effective as possible. “It’s got a real closeup film [feel to it] where anything on her face will be read as something,” he adds. To achieve this, the team programmed a wide array of animated micro-expressions into the writer’s software, allowing lines of dialogue to pair precisely with specific expressions. “[We’re] trying to get this kind of ambiguity and uncanniness, which makes people feel real,” he adds.

Prove You’re Human’s technological atmosphere toes the line between welcoming and unnerving – through it, Siu is reminiscing on interfaces of aesthetic note like the dreamlike wrapping of Final Fantasy XI’s PlayOnline Viewer, and the technology of the prophetic 1998 anime Serial Experiments Lain. “There’s something to be said about Frutiger Aero being a bit of an interesting desire for innocence and naivety when it comes to computing and the internet,” notes Siu. “It feels like a time when we were optimistic or anxious about something on the horizon, which felt like an interesting space to explore in relation to what is happening in the game.”

While Siu was keen to keep the specifics of Prove You’re Human close to their chest, they do hope players are left feeling a sense of bewilderment when they hit credits. “One way that we’ve been thinking about it is that it feels like a bit of a possession story.”

  • Prove You’re Human is coming soon to PC.

content_html_zh:
Sunset Visitor 工作室长期以来一直坚信电子游戏是思考社会问题的有效工具。 其获得皮博迪奖的项目 1000XResist 融入了开发团队对新冠疫情的复杂感受。 “我们非常习惯于将世界融入到作品中，”工作室创始人 Remy Siu 说道。 该公司的最新游戏《证明你是人类》延续了反思性游戏制作的传统，为玩家提供了以人工智能为中心的心理恐怖体验，他们必须使用一个确信其存在的学习模型进行推理。 “我们试图将自己置于[问题]中：作为一个人置身于这一切之中，有什么有效的感觉？” 萧说。

故事围绕桑塔纳展开，桑塔纳是一个活生生的人，为了工作，她选择将自己一分为二，并用她的数字克隆来测试公司产品，即名为 Mesa 的计算系统。 “（桑塔纳选择这样做的原因）很大程度上是为了让她的肉身拥有她所没有的生活，而她的数字版本则可以开始分娩，”Siu 说。 当桑塔纳的副本涉入日益模糊的道德水域时，她与梅萨纠缠在一起，完成超现实的 2D 和 3D 验证码来调查网络世界并停止幻觉。

将自己与工作分开的想法对于 Sunset Visitor 来说是一个特别有趣的吸引力，其开发人员植根于一系列创意学科。 “作为艺术家，当我们的工作成为我们生活的真实一部分时，我们往往最能与它保持一致，反之亦然，”萧指出。 在《证明你是人类》的构思期间，团队讨论了人们在日常生活中进行的微劳动，包括用于训练人工智能模型的内容。 “现在劳动意味着什么？” 萧问道。 “而且，人们与之有什么样的关系，因为这种关系在不断变化和发展，尤其是在这个时候，”他补充道。

《证明你是人类》中的一个争论点是梅萨完全相信他们在世界上有一个身体。 不过，在与桑塔纳的对话中，她看起来像一个巨大的头，被机械悬挂在太空中。 Siu 指出，因为在这些紧张时刻，梅萨的脸占据了屏幕的很大一部分，所以他们希望动画感觉尽可能真实和有效。 “这是一部真正的特写镜头[感觉]，她脸上的任何东西都会被解读为某种东西，”他补充道。 为了实现这一目标，该团队在作家的软件中编写了一系列动画微表情，使对话台词与特定表情精确配对。 “[我们]试图获得这种模糊性和神秘感，让人们感觉真实，”他补充道。

《证明你是人类》的科技氛围介于欢迎和令人不安之间——通过它，Siu 正在回忆具有美感的界面，比如《最终幻想 XI》的 PlayOnline Viewer 的梦幻包装，以及 1998 年预言性动画《Serial Experiments Lain》中的技术。 “在计算和互联网方面，Frutiger Aero 表现出一种对纯真和天真的有趣的渴望，这是值得一提的，”Siu 指出。 “感觉就像我们对即将发生的事情感到乐观或焦虑的时候，感觉这是一个与游戏中正在发生的事情相关的有趣的探索空间。”

虽然 Siu 热衷于将《证明你是人类》的具体细节保密，但他们确实希望玩家在看到片尾字幕时感到困惑。 “我们一直在思考这个问题的一个方式是，它感觉有点像一个占有的故事。”

  • 《证明你是人类》即将登陆 PC 版。
